messages:
sam (support): Hey team, escalating a customer issue (CASE-5421) — multiple customers on SSO are hitting 401s when calling our API. They report intermittent failures: some requests succeed, others fail with signature errors. Happening since key rotation yesterday. Can eng-security & runtime triage?

alex.r: which error codes/logs do we have? 401 with what reason?

sam (support): From customer logs: 'signature verification failed' and 'kid not found'. We also have backend traces showing signature error followed by success for same client within seconds. Copying snippet: 

token-bot: LOG: [1790001109] verify_jwt: signature_verification_failed, token_id=tok_abc123, issuer=https://idp.example.com, kid=JX-8aY
token-bot: LOG: [1790001110] jwks_cache: cache_hit issuer=https://idp.example.com, cached_keys=3, age=23h

alex.r: cache_age 23h — that's suspicious if the IdP rotates keys hourly. What is our JWKS cache TTL?

ben_k: Runtime config: jwks_cache_ttl default=24h, jwks_cache_refresh_on_miss=false. We added the cache to avoid rate limits on IdP.

priya.s: Also seeing some 'token expired' errors from the same timeframe: LOG: [1790001125] verify_jwt: token_expired, skew=-7s. Clients in APAC with weird clocks.

mika-oncall: Quick repro from support using curl (customer token redacted):

```bash
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGci...<redacted>" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "error": "invalid_token",
  "reason": "signature_verification_failed"
}
```

sam (support): Repro steps from customer:
1) Acquire SSO token via their IdP (Auth0)
2) Call /v1/generate with header above
3) ~50% of calls return 401 as above. If they retry after 2-5s, sometimes succeeds.

alex.r: Hypothesis: JWKS rotated at IdP, our local cache is stale, kid not in cached JWKS -> we return 401 immediately instead of refetching. Also clock skew could cause transient exp errors.

ben_k: Agreed. Two mitigations: 1) lower jwks_cache_ttl to something like 5m and enable refresh_on_miss so we attempt a fetch when kid is missing; 2) add allowed_clock_skew of 120s to issuer validation. But need safety review for refresh_on_miss to avoid dogpiling on IdP.

priya.s: For dogpiling we can do: when miss -> async refresh with singleflight, but meanwhile treat kid-miss as soft-fail for N seconds? That has security implications.

alex.r: We should not accept unsigned tokens or change alg checks. But we can implement a short synchronous refetch on kid-miss with strict retry/backoff (eg 1 try, 200ms timeout), and if still missing return 401. Also log metrics: jwks_refetch_attempts and jwks_kid_misses.

token-bot: CONFIG: jwks_cache_ttl=5m, jwks_refresh_on_miss=singleflight, jwks_refetch_timeout=250ms, allowed_clock_skew=120s (proposed)

sam (support): Customer asked for workaround — they can retry and it may succeed. Anything we can tell them to reduce failures now?

alex.r: Ask customers to retry on 401 for now; we want to push a hotfix ASAP. Also ask IdP to increase JWKS key publishing window if possible.

ben_k: I'll open a PR to change runtime defaults and add fallback refetch on kid-miss. Minimal patch: 

```go
// on verify JWT
if !jwks.Contains(kid) {
  // try a single synchronous refetch with timeout
  if fetchJWKS(issuer, timeout=250*time.Millisecond) {
    if !jwks.Contains(kid) { return ErrSignature }
  } else {
    return ErrSignature // still fail if cannot fetch
  }
}
// then proceed to verify
```

priya.s: Also add allowed_clock_skew in config and apply to exp/nbf checks. 120s should cover most client NTP drift without weakening security much.

mika-oncall: Suggest we emit a specific error code for kid-miss vs signature failure so support can triage customers quickly: e.g., invalid_token.kid_not_found and invalid_token.signature_mismatch.

alex.r: Good idea. Also instrument alert if jwks_kid_miss rate > 1% of verifications for an issuer over 10m.

ben_k: I'll include metrics + logs in the PR. Plan: patch to staging tonight, run smoke tests, then roll to prod with canary.

sam (support): ETA? Customer is asking for timeline.

ben_k: ETA 6 hours to staging, 12 hours prod with canary if tests pass. I'll post link to PR once ready.

token-bot: ALERT: [1790001340] external_rate_limit: idp_auth0 nearing threshold for automated jwks pulls (85%)

priya.s: If IdP rate limit is tight we should ensure singleflight + jitter to avoid amplifying. Also consider a short backoff after 429 and a circuit breaker per issuer.

alex.r: Security note — do not relax alg validation. Reject tokens that specify alg="none" or alg not in allowed list. For rotated keys, rely on kid lookup and refetch only, not fallback to arbitrary key selection.

mika-oncall: I'll create incident doc with timeline and mitigation steps for CASE-5421 and add support messages for customers: retry + expected fix window.

sam (support): Thanks all — please @sam (support) when PR is up so I can update the customer.

ben_k: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/2987 (WIP) — includes jwks_ttl change, singleflight fetch_on_miss, metrics, and allowed_clock_skew config.

alex.r: Reviewed the PR quickly, left comments re: tighter timeout and additional unit tests for kid-miss path.

priya.s: After deploy we should run a synthetic with rapid key rotation to validate the backoff and singleflight behavior. I'll add a test harness.

mika-oncall: Cool. I'll update the incident doc and set a follow-up to verify post-deploy.

sam (support): Customer notified: we will roll fix within 12 hours, suggested temporary retry. Closing loop later. :thumbsup:
